findings.title: Recovery precedence conflicts when COMMIT succeeds but terminal sidecar append is partial or corrupt
findings.evidence: Sections 43-44 require full sidecar validation and fail closed on malformed/truncated bytes even if a receipt exists. Sections 43 and 48 say a committed receipt recovers the result when the committed event append/Sync fails. A failed append can leave a truncated/invalid JSONL row, so the same restart fixture satisfies both incompatible outcomes.
findings.required_change: Specify separate outcomes for an intact prior sidecar with append/Sync failure versus partial/corrupt terminal bytes, define recovery precedence and a trustworthy proof boundary, and add a deterministic restart injection test after COMMIT with a partial terminal event.
